errors.notConnected: Not connected yet: enter the address and API key of the other Homey.
errors.noAddress: Enter the IP address of the other Homey.
errors.flowRefs: Cards that start other flows could not be updated
errors.appSettings: The API key may not read app settings. Create a key with the Apps permission (not read only) and connect again.
errors.favorites: The API key may not read your user data (favorites). Create a key with the Users permission and connect again.
errors.widgetImport: Update Compact Widgets to version 0.11 or newer and try again
errors.groupMembers: None of the members is matched on this Homey. Add the devices first (or via Homey Link).
errors.noTargetToken: Enter an API key of this Homey first.

settings.title: Flow Mover
settings.intro: Copy flows from your other Homey (e.g. the Homey Pro) to this Homey. Devices and variables are matched by name. The flows on the other Homey are not changed.
settings.step1Hint: Enter the IP address of the Homey that has your flows now, and an API key of that Homey.
settings.keyHelp: How do I create an API key?
settings.key1: Open my.homey.app in a browser and select the Homey that has your flows now (e.g. the Pro) at the top.
settings.key2: Go to Settings → API Keys → New API Key.
settings.key3: Give it a name (e.g. Flow Mover) and tick Flows (read and write, for bridge flows and switching) and read access to Devices, Logic, Zones, Users and Dashboards, and the Apps permission (needed to copy the Compact Widgets settings).
settings.key4: Copy the key and paste it below. You can delete it again after moving.
settings.tokenSaved: API key saved (leave empty to keep it)
settings.step2Hint: Each device of the other Homey is matched to one device here: first via Homey Link (it remembers the original device), then by name + room, then by name when that is unambiguous. Choose doubtful ones yourself; your choice is remembered.
settings.otherApp: via another app (e.g. Homey Link): special cards may be missing
settings.step3Hint: ✓ ready · ! with a remark · ✕ problem (the flow is created but will have broken cards) · = already exists on this Homey.
settings.exists: A flow with this name already exists on this Homey.
settings.issue_app: App not installed on this Homey: {name}
settings.issue_card: Card does not exist on this Homey: {name}
settings.issue_zone: Zone does not exist here yet: {name} (create the zones in step 4)
settings.issue_otherApp: {name} is matched to a device of another app
settings.issue_flowRef: Starts the flow “{name}”, which is not (yet) on this Homey
settings.optEnabled: Create flows enabled (otherwise disabled, so they don't run twice while the other Homey still runs them)
settings.confirmBad: Note: {n} flow(s) have a problem and will contain broken cards.
settings.confirmEnabled: The flows will be enabled. Disable them on the other Homey to avoid double actions.
settings.stepMissing: What is missing on this Homey?
settings.stepMissingHint: The apps and variables of the other Homey that your flows need but that are not here yet, and apps that have an older version here (flow cards may then be missing). Install or update them first: with the API key of this Homey (step 1) the button installs the app directly; without it, it opens the App Store, click Install there and choose this Homey. Then click Refresh. After installing an app, add its devices yourself; step 3 then matches them automatically.
settings.noMissingApps: All apps your flows and dashboards use are installed on this Homey.
settings.noMissingVars: All variables already exist on this Homey.
settings.cliApp: Installed by yourself (not from the App Store). Install it from your PC in the app's folder with
settings.stepZonesHint: Devices added via Homey Link or added again often sit in the root zone. This rebuilds the zones of the other Homey (floors, rooms) and puts the matched devices in the same room as on the other Homey.
settings.zonesOk: All matched devices are already in the same zone as on the other Homey.
settings.zonesSummary: {zones} zone(s) to create · {devices} device(s) to move
settings.zonesConfirm: Move {n} device(s) to their zone and create the zones needed?
settings.stepDashHint: Copy your dashboards with all widgets. Devices, zones and flows in the widgets are converted to those of this Homey. Do this after the flows so flow buttons are right at once. A dashboard with the same name gets “(copy)” after its name.
settings.noDashboards: No dashboards found on the other Homey.
settings.dashExists: A dashboard with this name already exists (will be created as a copy).
settings.optWidgetSettings: Also copy the settings of Compact Widgets (gauge panels, icons, chosen values of inverter/boiler/charger); replaces the current settings of that app on this Homey
settings.stepFavHint: Takes over your favorites (devices, flows) from the other Homey, added to what is already a favorite here. Do this last, so the flows exist. Favorites that cannot be converted are skipped. Other users set their own favorites.
settings.noFavorites: No favorites found on the other Homey.
settings.favDone: Favorites copied. Restart the Homey app on your tablet or phone to see them.
settings.versionsOk: No apps with an older version than on the other Homey.
settings.cliUpdate: Installed by yourself: update from your PC in the app's folder with
settings.versionsNewer: Newer here than on the other Homey (no problem):
settings.noSystem: No groups, Matter or other built-in devices missing.
settings.sysHelp_group: Can be rebuilt here with the same name, class, zone and icon and the members that are already matched (do this after the members exist). Step 3 then matches them automatically.
settings.sysHelp_matter: Matter devices can be shared with several controllers: share them from the Pro (or the manufacturer's app) with this Homey, or bring them in with Homey Link. Give them the same name.
settings.sysHelp_virtualsocket: Homey's built-in devices: create them again here with the same name, or bring them in with Homey Link.
settings.sysHelp_other: Homey's built-in device type (not an app): add it again here with the same name, or bring it in with Homey Link.
settings.targetHint: Homey only lets an app read its own Homey. To create variables, flows, zones, groups, dashboards and favorites, an API key of this Homey (the SHS) is needed.
settings.tkey1: Open my.homey.app and select this Homey (the Self-Hosted Server) at the top.
settings.tkey2: Go to Settings → API Keys → New API Key, e.g. “Flow Mover (write)”.
settings.tkey3: Tick all permissions (Devices, Flows, Logic, Zones, Dashboards, Users, Apps), copy the key and paste it below. Delete it after moving.
settings.targetOk: API key of this Homey saved and tested.
settings.targetMissing: No API key of this Homey yet: creating (variables, flows, …) will fail with “Missing Scopes”.
settings.installFallback: The app's page in the App Store opens now: install it there on this Homey.
settings.notOnSource: Not installed on the other Homey either: the app was removed there, but these flow(s) still use it and are already broken there: {flows}. Check if you still need them; otherwise leave them out when moving.
settings.appLinked: {n} already here via e.g. Homey Link
settings.appUnused: not used in flows or dashboards
settings.appAllLinked: All devices are already here through Homey Link: only install the app if you want the devices directly on this Homey.
settings.appsShowAll: Also show apps not used in flows or dashboards ({n})
settings.noUsers: No other users on the other Homey.
settings.userInvited: Invited: send this link to that person. After accepting (signing in with their own Homey account) they are recognised and flows with that user are right.
settings.inviteUsers: Create invitations for the ticked users
settings.how_ambiguous: several devices with this name: choose yourself
settings.how_missing: no device with this name found
settings.allDevices: Also show devices not used in flows ({n}) — they count for Rooms and zones
settings.how_values: matched by name + the same current values
settings.optBridge: Create bridge flows: triggers that only exist on the other Homey (buttons, remotes via Homey Link) stay there and start the flow here
settings.noLinkTargets: No Homey found in the Homey Link app of the other Homey: create one flow there with the Homey Link card “Start flow”, then this Homey is recognised.
settings.issue_bridge: Trigger “{name}” only exists on the other Homey: becomes a bridge flow (on the other Homey the trigger starts this flow; folders “Bridge to SHS” and “Bridge from Pro”)
settings.issue_noBridge: Trigger only exists on the other Homey and cannot be bridged automatically ({name})
settings.stepSwitchHint: The moved flows are disabled. Switch them over here per group: the flow here and its bridge flow are enabled, the original flow on the other Homey is disabled. If something doesn't work, “Back” undoes it. This needs write access to Flows in the API key of the other Homey.
settings.switchHereConfirm: Switch {n} flow(s): enable here and the bridge flow, disable on the other Homey?
settings.switchBackConfirm: Put {n} flow(s) back: enable on the other Homey, disable here and the bridge flow?
settings.zonesGroupedHint: These devices are in a device group. Homey doesn't allow moving them on their own: they are always in the zone of their group. They move along when the group is moved to its room.
